text:
elaine: I opened an emergency docs PR for the outage hotfix — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321. Needs quick approvals and merge. CI preview is returning 404 on staging.

rahul: On it, doing a quick review now. @james can you scan for any inaccuracies between Dedicated vs Hosted wording?

james: Reading through — generally fine. Add status page link and one-liner workaround. Small nit: rephrase the sentence about token bucket behavior.

elaine: Added status page link and workaround note: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-742. CI preview still 404 though.

deploy-bot: docs-preview failed — build 2257 — Error: Missing assets (404) at /en/latest/serving/rate-limits.html

ivy: I can take a look at the asset pipeline. Looks like the PR references images from /static/ that weren't included. Pushing a fix now (will re-run preview).

rahul: Will approve once preview renders. Also recommend we backport to branch `live-docs` after merge.

james: +1 for wording otherwise. Please add a known-issues entry under /known-issues/outages.md referencing INC-742 and include the rollback steps.

elaine: Done — added a short known-issues note and a rollback snippet:

```
git checkout live-docs
git revert <commit-hash>
make deploy-docs
```

elaine: @ivy any ETA on the preview rebuild?

ivy: Pushed fix and retriggered preview build 2258. ETA ~2m.

deploy-bot: docs-preview succeeded — preview URL: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4321

rahul: LGTM. Approving now.

james: Approved as well. Ops asked to avoid merges during the next 15m deploy, but this is an emergency hotfix — we should merge and backport immediately.

elaine: Merging and cherry-picking to `live-docs` now. Will ping SRE for rollout monitoring.

elaine: Merged and backported to `live-docs`. Triggered live deploy.

deploy-bot: live deploy started — job 8812. ETA 5m.

ivy: Updated known-issues/outages.md with the workaround snippet and added a short changelog entry.

elaine: Filed the rollback playbook in the incident thread and linked it from the docs: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-742#workaround

james: Suggest we add a docs-ci check to catch missing static assets to avoid the 404 in future.

rahul: Good call — I'll open a follow-up PR to add that pipeline check.

elaine: @oncall-sre please watch the deploy for any increase in 429s and escalate as needed.

deploy-bot: live deploy succeeded — job 8812 — docs now serving at https://docs.redwood.ai/serving/rate-limits

ivy: Verified the page and images load correctly.

james: Closing ack :thumbsup:
